name: Euclidean Distance Field (EDF) Data Structure
definition: Space skipping traversal using tiled 256³ Euclidean distance fields at 1:4 resolution, combined with 4³ occupancy bitmasks.
summary: The Euclidean Distance Field is a spatial indexing structure that accelerates ray traversal in dense voxel volumes by storing scalar distance magnitudes to skip empty space, distinguishing itself from boundary-based layouts.
